verdict.rationale: The only bulk capability in the evidence is CSV import and export of products, including product categories (swell-docs-14). That covers mass data movement for the catalog, but nothing shows programmatic or agent-driven bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: a batch/bulk API endpoint, bulk edit or update across other models (orders, customers, inventory), CLI or agent-accessible bulk operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
